descripcion_geo: Oasis in the Sinai desert with twelve water fountains and seventy palm trees; Israel's first pleasant stop after crossing the Red Sea.
importancia_estrategica: Oasis of rest and divine provision in the desert.

historias.descripcion: After the bitter water of Marah, Israel arrives at Elim where there are twelve fountains and seventy palm trees; They camp by the waters.
The twelve fountains of Elim symbolically correspond to the twelve tribes of Israel; The oasis is a preview of the promised land.
Elim was one of the stations on the exodus itinerary between the Red Sea and the Sinai.

personajes.descripcion: He led the people from bitter Mara to pleasant Elim as a sign of divine provision.
They rested in Elim after the miracle of the bitter waters of Marah.
He walked with Moses and Israel through the desert to Elim.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Elim: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Elim, with its twelve fountains and seventy palm trees, is a foretaste of the promised land: God's providence gives rest along the way.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Elim, with its twelve fountains and seventy palm trees, is a foretaste of the promised land: God's providence gives rest along the way.
